| [CLAIM-291](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-291.md) v2 | Adjoint kernel is the conjugate transpose | The record's own step, written down in [THEORY-009](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-009.md) and marked there as not the Riesz article's, which covers matrices and bounded operators only. For a kernel k in L²(μ⊗ν), the operator (Tf)(x) = ∫ k(x,y) f(y) dν(y) from L²(ν) to L²(μ) has adjoint (T*g)(y) = ∫ k̄(x,y) g(x) dμ(x), by Cauchy–Schwarz and Fubini. So T is self-adjoint, when μ = ν, exactly when k(x,y) = k̄(y,x) almost everywhere. | [CLAIM-382](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-382.md) v2 | Autoencoder representations are rotation-invariant | [THEORY-288](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-288.md)'s symmetry argument, stated as the record's own and proved. Transform the parameters by orthogonal maps Q_l of the hidden spaces that commute with the activation. The network then computes Q_l h_l and the same output, so the loss is invariant. Gradient steps commute with the transformation, and an i.i.d. Gaussian initialisation is invariant under it, so the law of the trained representations is too. For radial activations this is all of O(n), and no basis is privileged in law. For elementwise ones it is a finite group, so the axes may be privileged. Whether they are, and how strongly, is [THEORY-288](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-288.md)'s empirical content. The argument needs an orthogonally equivariant optimiser, and fails for Adam. | Active |

Permutations alone leave a barrier between two copies of one function that differ by per-unit rescaling, and quotienting rescaling removes it. A trained curve joins aligned endpoints that the straight line does not, both across the board and in the one flat, poorly connected cell of a load-by-temperature grid, where the accuracy deficit stays. So in this toy, connectedness after alignment is a property of width, of the symmetry group and of the path family, more than of the mechanism. A memory that keeps u and acts on it makes every outcome a success, so the next percept says nothing about u: its nostalgia is its whole content, ln 2 per step in the noiseless limit. The same memory with the action fixed lets the outcome reveal u, and its nostalgia is 0. Its heat per step is the same, because the policy only moves dissipation between the switch and the relaxation. Without feedback a memory's nostalgia is fixed by the memory and the drive; with feedback the use that makes the memory worth having is what makes it nonpredictive. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CLAIM-1197](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1197.md) | Four conditions for an optimal learning policy | Filed by the lead run of 2026-11-23, for the lead asking which assumptions a scalar optimum of learning needs. [CLAIM-754](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-754.md) says a scalar ranks learning processes once a task distribution, costs, horizon and preferences are declared; this states the conditions exactly and shows that one of them is more than is needed and the list less than enough. A fixed task distribution is not needed: a declared law that depends on what has been learned is a Markov decision process over the learner's organization, and backward induction gives an optimum. What can fail is the valuation ([CLAIM-1036](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1036.md)) and the finiteness and attainment of the best value ([CLAIM-1130](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1130.md)). The existence theorems are standard; the claim's own content is placing learning's effect on later tasks inside them. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CLAIM-1199](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1199.md) | Optimizer and network share conflict regulation | Alternative B. [CLAIM-367](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-367.md) says that in conventional training "most of that governance falls to the optimizer–model–data system", and argues from the relations outside the network. In the run ([CLAIM-1030](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1030.md)) the learned state accounted for 0.58 of the variation in how much of one task the network gave up, against 0.39 for the optimizer, in networks trained by heavy ball; and 0.15 against 0.81 in networks trained by Adam. Where governance sits is then not a fixed fact about conventional training but a result of it: the training optimizer decides how much of the later regulation of conflict the network comes to hold. On this reading the claim's "most" is an overstatement, though its defeat condition is not met. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
